title: Image generation returns, and audio gets more room
summary:
Image generation and editing returned to `gptimage`, audio requests got more room, and Enter’s FAQ and API key labels became easier to use.

`gptimage` was re-enabled for text-to-image generation and image editing with seed-tier access. `openai-audio` now accepts up to 10,000 input characters and 6,384 completion tokens. The same PR moved `openai-reasoning` to its Azure Myceli configuration.

Enter’s Pollen FAQ now appears on the sign-in page, with clearer answers about daily grants, model access, wallets and Quests. Its answers moved to markdown, and a follow-up fix made list bullets display properly.

Descriptions entered when creating API keys are now saved and shown in the key table instead of being replaced by a placeholder.

highlights.title: GPT Image returns
highlights.text: Use `gptimage` for text-to-image generation and image editing with seed-tier access, at up to 1024 pixels on the longest side. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).

highlights.title: More room for audio
highlights.text: `openai-audio` now accepts up to 10,000 input characters and 6,384 completion tokens. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).
